# nico_network_security_group (Resource)

Network Security Group is a security policy that controls the traffic flowing between Instances.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nico_network_security_group" "example" {
  name                           = "name-value"
  site_id                        = "site-id-value"
  description                    = "description-value"
  labels                         = {
    key = "value"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the Network Security Group
- `site_id` (String) ID of the Site

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the Network Security Group
- `labels` (Map of String) User-defined key-value labels for the Network Security Group
- `network_security_group_id` (String) Path parameter: network_security_group_id.
- `rules` (Attributes List) Rules that belong to the Network Security Group (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules))
- `stateful_egress` (Boolean) Egress rules with protocol and destination ports defined but without source ports defined should automatically be made stateful.

### Read-Only

- `attachment_stats` (Attributes) Attachment statistics for the Network Security Group. Returned when the `includeAttachmentStats` query parameter is set to true in retrieval endpoints. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--attachment_stats))
- `created` (String) Date/time when the Network Security Group was created
- `id` (String) The resource ID.
- `rule_count` (Number) Number of rules in the Network Security Group
- `status` (String) Status of the Network Security Group
- `status_history` (Attributes List) Chronological status history for the Network Security Group (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--status_history))
- `tenant_id` (String) ID of the Tenant
- `updated` (String) Date/time when the Network Security Group was last updated

<a id="nestedatt--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules`

Read-Only:

- `action` (String) Action applied when traffic matches the rule
- `destination_port_range` (String) Destination port or port range matched by the rule
- `destination_prefix` (String) Destination CIDR prefix matched by the rule
- `direction` (String) Traffic direction the rule applies to
- `name` (String) Name of the Network Security Group rule
- `priority` (Number) Rule priority used to order evaluation
- `protocol` (String) Network protocol matched by the rule
- `source_port_range` (String) Source port or port range matched by the rule
- `source_prefix` (String) Source CIDR prefix matched by the rule


<a id="nestedatt--attachment_stats"></a>
### Nested Schema for `attachment_stats`

Read-Only:

- `direct_instance_attachment_count` (Number) Number of Instances that directly attach this Network Security Group
- `direct_vpc_attachment_count` (Number) Number of VPCs that directly attach this Network Security Group
- `in_use` (Boolean) Whether the Network Security Group is directly attached to at least one object
- `total_direct_attachment_count` (Number) Total number of objects that directly attach this Network Security Group
